svg.title: Step 2: power supply, relay and humidifier
svg.text: Step 2: power supply, relay and humidifier
The ESP32 switches the atomizer board's 5 V through the relay.
If the atomizer does not start misting by itself
Test first: switch its power off and on several times. If it mists every time, skip this box.
A. Simplest: bridge the S1 pads
Solder a short wire across the two S1 button pads.
The board then starts as soon as the relay powers it.
B. Or: a PC817 optocoupler presses the button
Pins 4 and 3 go across the button pads. Then set "button presses after
